TmSankeyChartDemo_Description: Follow monthly income through the household budget into spending and savings. Hover a node or flow to trace its connections, then select it for details.
TmSankeyChartDemo_ClickPrompt: Select a node or flow to inspect it.
TmChartDemo_PageDescription: Pure SVG charts with no JavaScript dependencies, including stacked bars, multi-series areas and cumulative waterfalls.
TmChartDemo_AreaBalance: Operating and reserve balances, two series
TmChartDemo_AreaEdge: Gradient fill, negative values and a missing point
TmChartDemo_StackedDescription: Vertical and horizontal views share the same monthly expense composition. Toggle a category to remove it from every stack.
TmChartDemo_WaterfallStandard: Cashflow: opening balance, receipts, expenses and final balance
TmToolbarDemo_OverflowIntro: Buttons that do not fit move into a More menu, Secondary buttons first; Export and Delete are overflow-only and always live there. The menu is a bottom sheet on a phone. Arrow keys move between the buttons.
TmToolbarDemo_RibbonTitle: Ribbon with labels below the icons
TmToolbarDemo_RibbonDescription: Icon over label, groups separated by dividers - the tablet layout of the diagram editor mockup.
TmToolbarDemo_PressedDescription: A button with Pressed renders aria-pressed and the pressed look; collapsed into the More menu it is a checkable entry (menuitemcheckbox) with the same state. Activating it closes the menu and toggles.
TmToolbarDemo_LabelsDescription: Auto shows button labels and drops them when the toolbar itself is narrower than 640 px (the text stays the accessible name).
TmToolbarDemo_FileButtonDescription: A Secondary file button leaves the bar into More like any other button; its More entry opens the same file chooser. Narrow the bar and pick a JSON file from either place.
TmToolbarDemo_ItemsIntro: Selects, colour pickers and toggles leave the bar like buttons: the wrapper is one measured item, it collapses whole, and in More it is a plain entry or a labelled group.
TmToolbarDemo_ItemsColorDialogBody: The full colour picker opened from the More menu (the menu stays open under it).
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusTitle: Buttons that do not steal focus (PreserveFocus)
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusDescription: A toolbar button with PreserveFocus does not take focus on a pointer press, so the text selection in the field survives the formatting command.
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusSample: Select part of this text, then press a formatting button — the selection survives.
TmToolbarDemo_GroupDescription: A TmToolbarGroup renders role=group with an accessible name and the data-tm-toolbar-group marker: its buttons still collapse individually and come back when there is room. Save is pinned and never moves into More.
TmToolbarDemo_GroupMenuTitle: Grouped commands in the More menu
TmToolbarDemo_GroupMenuDescription: Buttons grouped in TmToolbarGroup keep a labelled section in the More menu; the arrow keys cross the groups and skip the headings.
TmToolbarDemo_ConditionalDescription: A button inserted in the middle of the bar after the first render: the More menu and the tie-break follow the DOM order.
TmToolbarDemo_OverflowOnlyMidDescription: Export is written between New and Copy and lives only in More: the menu keeps that written position.
TmToolbarDemo_ShrinkDescription: The toolbar is a size container with no intrinsic width: in a space-between flex row it needs flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_Intro: A component-scoped action bar: up to three actions stay on the bar, the rest overflow into a More menu. Resize the window below 640 px (or open this page on a phone) and the bar appears; above the breakpoint it does not exist.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_AutoTitle: Auto visibility, sticky in the container
TmMobileActionBarDemo_AutoDescription: The bar below belongs to this card. Scroll the page: it sticks to the bottom edge only while its container is in view; the content scrolls beneath it. Only the deliberate FixedViewport variant reserves clearance for itself.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_ForcedDescription: The same bar with a forced mobile layout, so it renders at any window width. The second variant anchors to the viewport deliberately (FixedViewport); the third is static (Inline).
TmMobileActionBarDemo_FixedBody: This content scrolls under the viewport-anchored bar; the reserve below equals the bar height.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_ConfirmDeleteMessa: The document will be moved to the trash. You can restore it later.
TmDataTableDemo_ExportDescription: Open the Export menu to download every matching row, or only the rows you have checked, as CSV or as a typed Excel workbook (XLSX).
TmDataTableDemo_InlineEditDescription: Edit the amount, category, and note in place. DataAnnotations block invalid values, and a successful save reports the OnRowSave callback below. Cancel callbacks receive the mutated item, so applications that need rollback must restore their own snapshot.
TmDataTableDemo_SavePlaceholder: Save a valid row to see the OnRowSave result.
TmDataTableDemo_RedesignDescription: Every control below is off by default. Turn one on to see that opt-in without changing the tables above.
TmDataTableDemo_MobileCardsDescription: This container is 24rem wide, so the cards layout is visible on a desktop too.
TmDataTableDemo_ViewsDescription: The panel lists personal views, shows the active view's name and offers Set as default. The container is 24rem wide, so the panel becomes a sheet.
TmDataTableDemo_FilterDemoDescription: Popover keeps the editor anchored. Auto uses the same panel and becomes a sheet below 640px. Both show how many people match.
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeDescription: Fixed data for the end-to-end and screenshot specs: an empty table, no results after a search, a loading table, a very long cell and view name, and fifteen columns that scroll.
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongHeading: Very long cell text and view name
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongName: Maximilian Alexander Bartholomew Christopher Fitzgerald-Montgomery the Third of Westminster and Greater Manchester
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongView: Engineering and Platform department — quarterly pipeline review for the northern and eastern regions
TmMvlDemo_EdgeLongTitle: Maximilian Alexander Bartholomew Christopher Fitzgerald-Montgomery the Third of Westminster
TmMvlDemo_EdgeLongSubtitle: Principal staff engineer responsible for the platform, tooling and developer experience organisation across every region
TmDataTableDemo_EdgePagerHeading: Pager in a wide and a narrow container
TmDataTableDemo_GridEditDescription: F2 starts editing the focused row, Escape cancels and returns focus to the cell.
TmMvlDemo_RedesignDescription: Every control below is off by default. Turn one on to see that opt-in without changing the lists above.
TmDiagramDemo_InteractiveDescription: The canvas below is pre-loaded with a UML Class stencil. Drag from a port to create edges.
TmDiagramDemo_PageDescription: Declarative diagram editor with stencil-based nodes, SVG edges, and hybrid HTML/SVG rendering. Drag stencils from the toolbox, connect ports, and export as JSON.
TmEditorShellDemo_Intro: A responsive three-region frame for canvas editors: docked, resizable panels on desktop and tablet (one expanded on a tablet), canvas + a panels sheet and an action bar on mobile. Resize the window to watch it adapt.
TmEditorShellDemo_CanvasBody: We are glad you joined us. Here are a few tips to get started.
TmEditorShellDemo_CanvasFooter: You received this email because you signed up for our newsletter.
TmEditorShellDemo_ThresholdsIntro: The same shell with its own thresholds (desktop from 1200, mobile below 768, like the e-mail editor). On a tablet the toolbox collapses to an icon rail and one panel stays expanded.
TmEditorShellDemo_OverlayIntro: The same shell with TabletPanelPresentation.Overlay (desktop from 1200, mobile below 768). On a tablet the toolbox is an overlay drawer and the properties a non-modal side sheet over a full-width canvas - at most one open, driven by the toolbar buttons, closed by the x or Escape. Desktop keeps the docked panels.
TmSidePanelDemo_Intro: A standalone responsive inspector: docked in-flow on a desktop container, a modal side sheet on a narrower container, a bottom sheet on a phone viewport. Shrink the window to watch it adapt.
TmSidePanelDemo_InspectorBody: A standalone inspector for surfaces that are not full editors — a scheduler event, a Gantt task, a record detail.
TmDemo_InlineSheetBody: The canvas behind this sheet stays clickable.
TmDemo_LongCustomDialogFiller: Filler paragraph {0} — enough content to make the dialog scroller overflow.
TmDemo_MobileSheet: Opt-in bottom sheet on a phone (MobilePresentation = Auto)
TmDemo_FocusRestoreBody: This form starts in its first field. Close it (X, Cancel or Esc) and focus returns to the button that opened it. OK moves focus to "Post-close action" instead.
TmDemo_FocusRestoreNestedMessage: A dialog opened on top of the modal. Closing it returns the focus to the button that opened it.
TmModelingEditor_DemoError: Demo modeling provider failed to load the model.
TmCalendarHeatmapDemo_Description: Compare daily expenses across a year or focus on a custom date range.
TmCalendarHeatmapDemo_ClickPrompt: Select a day to inspect its expense.
TmResponsiveDemo_Intro: The same dashboard in four containers: 80rem, 58rem, 50rem and a 24rem column. Resize the browser, or force the wide container's layout below — the grid follows its container, not the browser window.
TmResponsiveDemo_RevealHint: Hover or focus to reveal the action. A touch screen shows it immediately.
TmRichEditorDemo_PromotedDrawerIntro: The drawer is in the browser top layer. Open a link, image, table, video or find dialog from the toolbar: it promotes after the drawer and paints above it; Escape closes it and focus returns to the editor.
TmRichEditorDemo_DrawerPlaceholder: Edit in the drawer — dialogs opened from the toolbar stay above it
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Subtitle: Manage the e-mails your application sends and keep their wording in one place.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_NoMatchDescription: Nothing matches “{0}”. Try another name or subject.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_DeleteBody: This template will be permanently deleted. Sent e-mails keep their content.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Send_Subtitle: Send a test e-mail with filled-in variables and preview the message.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Guard_Message: This template has unsaved changes. Save them before leaving?
